facts.business: Thirumalai Chemicals Limited manufactures commodity chemicals such as Phthalic Anhydride and a diversified portfolio of specialty chemicals and food ingredients including Fumaric Acid, Malic Acid, and Diethyl Phthalate, serving industries like food and beverages, pharmaceuticals, animal nutrition, fragrances, cosmetics, resins, and industrial formulations.

capacity_or_capex.item: New Phthalic Anhydride capacity in Gujarat through subsidiary
Capital expenditure for TCL Specialties LLC, USA manufacturing plant construction

guidance_or_targets.statement: Maximizing capacity utilization remains our primary strategic objective for the current fiscal year
Working with consortium banks to enhance non-funded working capital limits to support higher capacity utilization and restore competitive cost structures

auditor.name: Walker Chandiok & Co LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter: Impairment assessment of property, plant and equipment on Company's D1 Dahej Plant due to increased downtime and non-operational status for substantial part of the year

key_risks: Oversupply and margin compression in Phthalic Anhydride due to aggressive capacity additions by domestic competitors
Geopolitical volatility impacting raw material costs and working capital requirements
Higher import tariffs by the US affecting customer base
Reduced capacity utilization leading to inflated fixed costs and compromised utility efficiencies
Breach of financial covenants on non-convertible debentures and term loans
Impairment risk on D1 Dahej Plant due to increased downtime and adverse market conditions
Dependence on successful debt fundraising for TCL Specialties LLC (USD 130 million senior secured term loan) to meet liquidity needs
facts.related_party_note: Corporate guarantee of M/s Thirumalai Chemicals Limited, India for term loans of TCL Specialties LLC; Negative lien on shares held by Thirumalai Chemicals Limited in TCL Specialties LLC through its holding companies
